title: Topic 18
japanese_text: A社は小さな町工場だが高い技術力を持つ会社だ。そのA社に新しくロケット部品の<u>試作</u>依頼が入った。A社の職人たちは何日も<u>夜更け</u>まで<u>労力</u>を惜しまず<u>開発</u>に取り組み、<u>滞りなく</u> <u>納期</u>までに試作品を完成させた。
english_translation: Company A has a small factory in a small town, but it has strong technological capabilities. After receiving a request for a prototype of a new rocket component, its craftsmen worked until late at night to develop it, sparing no effort, completing the prototype without delaying the deadline.
